A_Q1_RESIDUAL.purpose: One four-arm comparison of nested residuals around the exact strong Q1; no new trajectories.

features.P64: top64 right singular vectors of stacked sqrt(1/(11*n_s))*X_s in F64
features.Q32: top32 right singular vectors of stacked sqrt(1/(11*n_s))*(Y_s-X_s@A_q1), ungated/pre-gate F64 residual
features.b: CAL equal-source/row pooled endpoint projection mean of U0@P32 and U1@P32
features.sigma: pooled endpoint std around b, clamp_min(1e-6)
features.raw_E: cat(X.double()@P32, tanh((U1.double()@P32-b)/sigma)-tanh((U0.double()@P32-b)/sigma)); first32 columns exactly same X.double()@P32 as Delta
features.normalized: Phi=Phi_raw/gamma; do not subtract feature mean

fit.solver: torch.linalg.solve(K+rho I, vec(T)); same flatten order as existing fit_readout

BF16_contract.L: fold (P64/gamma_L)@C_L@Q.T into A_q1 before one Qb; same residual replay
BF16_contract.P_Q: Qb(P32), Qb(Q32); do not absorb sigma into P
BF16_contract.Delta: base=original residual replay with A_linear_BF16; retain h0=u0@P32_BF16; v=Qb(tanh(((u1@P32_BF16).float()-h0.float())/sigma)); base=Qb(base.float()+((v@C_N_BF16)@Q32_BF16.T).float())
BF16_contract.claim: local512 cache/operator/gate replay; no final residual-stream writeback or video/timing claim

checks.C_zero: torch.equal to CURRENT_Q1 math AND BF16 prediction on first sorted CAL per site, actual consumer functions
checks.all_BF16_outputs: finite; loss of mathematical benefit is a scientific result
